actual_fraction.interpretation: No hydrologically meaningful drought stress is activated anywhere in the observed RA01 root-response panel.

actual_rate.interpretation: Actual root uptake equals prescribed potential transpiration to floating-point aggregation precision.

material_invariance.interpretation: The root-response trace is material-independent because the tested trajectories remain on the unstressed Feddes plateau.

route_difference_scale.interpretation: The non-monotone root-uptake uncertainty norms are floating-point aggregation differences around an effectively constant plateau response, not observed differences in drought-stress dynamics.

adjudication.reason: RA01's frozen all-metrics pass rule remains failed. Independently, the panel is scientifically non-discriminating for drought-limited root feedback because alpha-weighted uptake never departs meaningfully from potential transpiration.

next.requirement: Design a new root-active Reference panel prospectively from the frozen Feddes thresholds and an analytical water-budget/stress-activation bound so that at least one case must enter drought stress without choosing stress levels from reduced-candidate response.
prohibited: Do not tune a reduced candidate.
Do not reuse RA01 route errors to choose a candidate partition or feedback correction.
Do not change production root-water-uptake physics.
